name: BDD_Dataset
description: A Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) dataset for Python code generation benchmarks, translated from HumanEval and MBPP, fully execution-verified. BDD_Dataset contains 1,137 problems, 6,183 scenarios, and 21,122 steps from HumanEval and MBPP, each translated into Gherkin BDD format with executable Python Behave step definitions, paired with the original, human-authored HumanEval/MBPP canonical reference solution (not a model-generated artifact). Every problem is execution-verified: all scenarios pass against the reference solution via behave. No prior BDD dataset targets Python. GWT (Alcântara Júnior & Montandon, MSR'26), the only prior large-scale BDD dataset, covers Java/JavaScript/Ruby, is mined rather than executed, and explicitly names Python/Behave as future work. This dataset closes that gap. Files in this deposit: bdd_dataset.jsonl: the full dataset, all 1,137 problems, one JSON record per line. bdd_dataset_humanEval.jsonl: the HumanEval-derived subset only (164 problems). bdd_dataset_mbpp.jsonl: the MBPP-derived subset only (973 problems). sample.zip: a small, browsable illustration of the dataset in two forms: sample_bdd_dataset.jsonl: the same 4 example problems (HumanEval_0, HumanEval_1, MBPP_1, MBPP_2) in the standard jsonl record format, for a quick look at the schema without downloading the full file.
